text: Ruling needed: is appended-void the answer to "impossible to delete a wrong entry"? R-B8 freezes events as append-only/never-overwritten, but the outlier flow promises "an admitted typo is fixed". Proposal: a void/correction event tombstones the original (EAV attr); voided events are excluded from daily scalars, trend, and F07; audit trail intact. Alternative: hard delete with an import-log entry. Which do you want in the spec?

Where should the body-composition surface live? Today "Body-fat methods" is a secondary button inside the Today's weigh-ins card. Options: (a) peer segment inside F06's weight area (Weight | Body tabs), (b) its own hub card + route. And should the tape values (waist/neck/hip) persist as girth measurement events every time, with the BF estimate saved separately as an estimated series?

Goals editor writer id: should post-wizard goal edits write Targets versions as STUDIO_F01 (wizard = first run of the same editor, R-B2 unchanged), or do you want a distinct writer id for user manual edits so the ledger distinguishes wizard runs from later tweaks?
Why do we need an audit trail for a weight monitoring app ? Let the user delete.
I don't even understand why this matters. The user wants to change his target, who cares to know from what screen he  did it at any point in the future ?

Weight and BF are linked, should be on the same screen. Different series.
yes record mensuration too, it's important information for motivation.
Note that in the future BF can come from connected scale.

Implemented in four commits, each independently shippable: W1 delete door (2111643 — delete + deleteTrendScalars, deleteWeighIn with day-trend recompute, projector clears emptied days, outlier Keep/Delete, undo). W2 history-first surface (3b95e65 — logbook, 30d/90d/1y/all window selector, back-datable sheet, noon-default parser + tests). W3 same-screen body composition (66969b8 — Weight|Body-fat segments, BF/waist series, persisted headline method, tape saved as MEASURED girth events, tape prefill). W4 goals + profile facts (fdae12d — ProfileRepository.updateFacts, GoalsEditor over STUDIO_F01 with diff ribbon + versions ledger + revert, Settings→Goals/Profile).

Deferred: long-press-on-chart back-fill (back-datable sheet covers the need; chart gesture is polish). Connected tests not run this session (no emulator pass); unit + build + ktlint gates green.
